title: B2: Replace == Name == section headers with = Name
description: Update the section-header parsing rule in CooklangParser.swift (and/or Parser.swift) so that a line matching = <name> (exactly one leading =, a space, then the section name to end of line) opens a new section whose name is the captured text trimmed. The old == Name == syntax is dropped — lines starting with == become plain step text. All other section rules from spec 0001 are unchanged: implicit unnamed leading section for steps before the first = header, step numbering restarts at 1 in each named section, blank lines tolerated.
acceptance_criteria: = Name lines open a new section whose name is the captured text trimmed
== Name == lines are treated as plain step text — no section opened
Implicit unnamed leading section still works for steps before the first = header
Step numbering restarts at 1 in each named section (existing rule preserved)
